verdict.rationale: First-party sources describe Gitea as a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service. It ships as a single binary or an official container image, runs across many OSes, architectures and databases, and supports single-server or replicated deployment. Multiple independent community reports corroborate painless self-hosted installs, smooth Docker setups, simple binary-swap upgrades and low resource use on modest hardware.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.
Upgrades are super simple: stop the service, replace the single binary, start it again.
